shows.description:
Gold Roger was known as the Pirate King, the strongest and most infamous being to have sailed the Grand Line. The capture and death of Roger by the World Government brought a change throughout the world. His last words before his death revealed the location of the greatest treasure in the world, One Piece. It was this revelation that brought about the Grand Age of Pirates, men who dreamed of finding One Piece (which promises an unlimited amount of riches and fame), and quite possibly the most coveted of titles for the person who found it, the title of the Pirate King.

Enter Monkey D. Luffy, a 17-year-old boy that defies your standard definition of a pirate. Rather than the popular persona of a wicked, hardened, toothless pirate who ransacks villages for fun, Luffy’s reason for being a pirate is one of pure wonder; the thought of an exciting adventure and meeting new and intriguing people, along with finding One Piece, are his reasons of becoming a pirate. Following in the footsteps of his childhood hero, Luffy and his crew travel across the Grand Line, experiencing crazy adventures, unveiling dark mysteries and battling strong enemies, all in order to reach One Piece.

shows.description:
Crayon Shin-chan follows the wacky antics and adventures of five-year-old Shinnosuke "Shin" Nohara and his parents, neighbors, and friends and is set in Kasukabe, Saitama Prefecture, Japan.

Many of the jokes in the series stem from Shin-chan's occasionally weird, unnatural and inappropriate use of language, as well as from his inappropriate behavior. A typical gag involves Shin-chan confounding his parents by using the wrong phrase for the occasion; for example, saying "Welcome back!" instead of "I am back!" when he comes home.

During the beginning of the series, the TV show was mostly based on the storyline in the original manga. As the show progressed, more and more episodes became anime-original.

shows.description: The main character is a mother named Sazae-san. She lives in a house with her husband, her kid, her siblings and her parents. The show is the ultimate family program and tends to follow traditional themes. Think of this show as the Japanese equivalent to "The Partridge Family" and you'll get a good feel for this show's atmosphere. Don't expect to see things like violence, swearing, kung-fu action or magical girls. The plots are more like "Today, Sazae-san goes to the new mall and gets lost". Such "boring" plotlines and the simplistic art are often a turn-off to non-Japanese audiences, but most Japanese find the show incredibly good. As a result, it continues to be one of the top ratings grabbers on TV and is one of the few anime that is considered "acceptable" by adults.

In the Heian era, around 1000 years ago, a young boy of noble family named Ojarumaru is bored with his life of privilege. Meanwhile, three demons steal the power-stick of Enma, king of demons, and then lose it. Ojarumaru finds it, and uses it to transport himself to the present time. Here, he is befriended by a young boy named Kazuma, and becomes a member of his family. As time goes on, Ojarumaru makes many new friends, while dodging the comedic efforts of the three demons, Akane, Kisuke, and Aobee, as they try to recover the stick.

The novel takes place in the summer of 1907, the 40th year of the Meiji era. 15-year-old Inako Momokawa lives in the Fushimi area of Kyoto, and is the second daughter of a sake brewer. Nothing she does ever comes out right, and she receives a scolding from her father every day. Her only relief is the trust she places in her prayers to the gods. One day while at Fushimi Inari shrine, she meets a freewheeling young man named Kihachi Sakamoto. He rejects the gods, and boasts of the incoming age of electricity.

The topic of marriage suddenly comes up in Inako's household. Her father is one-sidedly making all the decisions for her, and Inako is about to give up hope. It is then that Kihachi draws out Inako's true feelings of wanting to run away from her family. The only way to stop her marriage is to find an unusual book called the "Electricity Catalog." The book is a prediction book about electricity that Kihachi wrote when he was a child, but his older brother Seiroku took the book, and its current whereabouts are unknown. Inako and Kihachi together go in search of the book across Kyoto and Shiga prefectures.

(Source: Anime News Network)

summaries.21: Gold Roger, the legendary Pirate King, left behind a treasure called One Piece before his execution, sparking a golden age where countless pirates set out to find it. Monkey D. Luffy, a cheerful seventeen-year-old with rubber powers, sets sail with his growing crew not for riches alone but for the thrill of adventure and meeting unforgettable people along the way. It's a sprawling, good-natured pirate epic built on found family, wild imagination, and battles against increasingly strange enemies.
summaries.235: Shinichi Kudo is a brilliant teenage detective known as the Modern Sherlock Holmes, until a shadowy organization poisons him and leaves him shrunk into the body of a child. Hiding his true identity, he moves in with his childhood friend Ran and her bumbling detective father, solving a steady stream of murders while quietly hunting the people who did this to him. It blends mystery-of-the-week cases with a long-running conspiracy simmering underneath.
summaries.966: Follows the everyday chaos caused by Shinnosuke "Shin" Nohara, a five-year-old with an uncanny talent for embarrassing his parents, neighbors, and teachers in the town of Kasukabe. Much of the humor comes from his bizarre, inappropriate turns of phrase and general disregard for how a small child is supposed to behave. It's an episodic family comedy that leans hard into silly, cringe-inducing gags rather than any ongoing story.
summaries.1199: Rantarou, Shinbei, and Kirimaru are first-year students at a ninja academy, more interested in food, money, and goofing off than mastering their craft. Each half-hour episode is split into two short, comedic segments following their misadventures alongside teachers, classmates, and a rival group of ninjas. It's a gentle, episodic gag comedy aimed at kids rather than a serialized ninja drama.
summaries.1960: A falling Star of Life brings a loaf of bread to life as Anpanman, a superhero with a head made of sweet bean-filled bread who helps the hungry and battles his germ-themed rival Baikinman. Told alongside a rotating cast of food-themed friends, it's a simple, kind-hearted series built for very young viewers. Each episode plays out as a self-contained lesson in sharing, courage, and helping others.
summaries.2406: Centers on Sazae-san, a mother living in a multi-generational household with her husband, child, siblings, and parents, going about ordinary domestic life. Plots are deliberately small-scale, things like a trip to a new mall going sideways, rendered in simple, old-fashioned art. It's a gentle, long-running family sitcom with no violence, edge, or fantasy elements.
summaries.4459: Ojarumaru is a bored young noble from the Heian era who stumbles onto a magic stick stolen from the demon king Enma and uses it to leap a thousand years into the present day. There he's taken in by a boy named Kazuma and settles into a new life, all while three bumbling demons chase him trying to get the stick back. It's a whimsical, low-stakes comedy built around fish-out-of-water culture clash.
summaries.6149: Momoko Sakura, nicknamed Chibi Maruko-chan for her small stature, is an ordinary elementary schooler who loves manga and pop idols and lives with her parents, grandparents, and older sister. Episodes follow her everyday life with a wide cast of classmates and friends at school and around her small town. It's a warm, low-key slice-of-life comedy about the simple ups and downs of childhood.
summaries.8336: A children's series about Kappa, folkloric water creatures, who each have a flower growing from their head. The premise is kept simple and playful, suited to very young viewers.
summaries.8687: A fresh adaptation of the long-running Doraemon franchise, produced by the same team behind the original 1979 series in association with Studio Pierrot. It brings new voice actors, staff, and updated character designs to the familiar robotic-cat premise.
summaries.10506: Follows a cat who travels around granting people's wishes and delivering happiness, with a name that plays on the Japanese words for seed and cat. It's a gentle, whimsical premise aimed at younger viewers.
summaries.18941: The fourth season of the long-running Shimajirou children's series, continuing its educational, early-childhood format. It's aimed squarely at very young viewers rather than a general audience.
summaries.21552: A new adaptation following three forest friends, a soft-spoken raccoon, an anxious squirrel, and a laid-back sea otter, as they wander through gentle, low-key adventures. It's a quiet, contemplative comedy more interested in small moments than plot.
summaries.101184: A collection of short promotional animations made for the Fate/Grand Order mobile game, aired on TV and posted to Type-Moon's YouTube channel to advertise the game or promote new in-game events. The animation in each commercial is original and doesn't appear in the game or the wider Fate/Grand Order anime series, making this a curiosity for franchise completists rather than a standalone story.
summaries.101424: Follows Taiga Akashi, an elementary schooler in modern-day Japan who dreams of becoming a professional gamer. It's a grounded, contemporary coming-of-age premise built around that ambition.
summaries.101906: Ratio is a girl living in an icy world alongside her hairy friend Jammon, learning small lessons from the spirits and people she meets each episode. It reads as a gentle, episodic fantasy aimed at younger viewers.
summaries.102763: A series of short commercials for miso soup maker Marukome, each telling a small, bittersweet vignette about everyday family life, from a mother and son's routine to a couple growing old together. They're brief mood pieces built around warmth and nostalgia rather than a connected story.
summaries.103303: Set in 1907 Kyoto, the story follows Inako Momokawa, the perpetually scolded second daughter of a sake brewer, who finds an unlikely spark of rebellion in Kihachi Sakamoto, a young man who scoffs at tradition and preaches the coming age of electricity. When her family starts arranging her marriage, Inako and Kihachi set off across Kyoto and Shiga in search of a mysterious lost book that might change her fate. It's a period romance built around clashing ideas of tradition and progress.
summaries.108992: After a shower of meteorites brings a strange, miracle-working substance called Mobius Dust to Earth, Japan's economic inequality spirals, fueling a wave of terrorism from those left behind. The police respond by forming a special task force and a school to train its members. It sets up a near-future story about class conflict and the people caught fighting it on both sides.
summaries.110694: A special project pairing well-known Japanese animation studios and creators with fictional Paralympic athletes, aiming to introduce new sports heroes through original characters and stories. It's a collaborative, awareness-driven anthology rather than a single continuous narrative.
summaries.113863: A short anime following a boy named Tarou as he transforms into the hero Gainaman. Little else about the premise is given beyond this basic superhero setup.
summaries.116787: Koyan, an origami ninja from the planet Origamio, comes to Earth searching for a magical stone called Hapiton that can make people happy, teaming up with childhood friend Namin and newcomer Lublin along the way. Their journey is complicated by Evilrun, a villain with a black hole in her stomach whose true goals remain a mystery. It's a colorful kids' adventure built around a search-and-thwart formula.
summaries.118123: Follows the eccentric cast of Hololive's virtual YouTubers as they stumble through absurd, everyday mishaps around the office, from mysterious doors to surprise packages that turn out to be bombs. It's a lighthearted comedy built around the VTubers' established personalities rather than any larger plot.
summaries.119080: A collection of short promotional animations for the mobile game Arknights, produced for TV and the game's official YouTube channel to advertise the title and its in-game events after its Japan launch. The animation is exclusive to these commercials and isn't found elsewhere in the game, making this a niche collection for fans of the franchise's visual side.
summaries.121080: An original anime series produced in cooperation with Kanagawa Prefecture. No further details about its story or characters are given.
summaries.124082: A collection of short promotional animations for the Azur Lane mobile game, posted to its official YouTube channel with animation exclusive to these commercials rather than the game or its TV series. It's a niche assortment of visual tie-in material rather than a standalone story.
summaries.128394: A mini-anime built around Shikaruneko, or Angry Cat, a character from manga creator agency wwwaap that's set to premiere on TV Tokyo. Beyond that announcement, little is known about the format or story.
summaries.128757: Aya Mitsuki enrolls at the elite Kuromi Girls' Academy hoping to become as refined as the school's flawless star student, Mio Yorue, only to catch her secretly playing fighting games. With Mio's cover blown, she challenges Aya to a match, and an unlikely friendship starts to form around their shared love of the genre. It's a lighthearted school comedy built on a fun clash between polished image and nerdy passion.
summaries.129963: A pair of teaser videos introducing hololive Alternative, described as another possible world for the Hololive VTuber franchise. They're brief promotional glimpses rather than a full story.
summaries.133007: Announced at the franchise's 10th anniversary event, this is a new film serving as an official sequel to the 2013 movie Rebellion. Beyond the announcement and its tagline promising the story continues, plot details are still under wraps, making it one for existing fans of the franchise to look forward to.
summaries.134107: The second season of Wu Shang Shen Di, continuing directly from where the first left off. No further plot details are given beyond that.
summaries.135865: The second season of Youjo Senki, picking up the story where the original series left off. No additional details about this season's plot are provided.
summaries.136862: Set in a cosmos split between an inner universe, home to realms of gods, immortals, and mortals, and an outer universe ruled by demons, with countless mortal worlds like the Tianfa Continent caught in between. Nine immortal emperors preside over the mortal side's many star fields, with a still higher realm of purified gods above them all. It's dense, hierarchy-heavy cultivation fantasy built on a sprawling cosmic setting.
summaries.137653: Wang Lin is an ordinary young man from the countryside who chooses to pursue immortality, driven less by a desire for long life than by resentment toward the powerful forces that look down on people like him. With middling natural talent but a sharp mind, he claws his way up through the cultivation world over a long, hard-won journey. It's a classic underdog cultivation story built on grit rather than natural gifts.
summaries.137671: Opens with nine dragons and a mysterious coffin as the gateway into a vast, ancient world, following a young man named Ye Fan as he climbs toward the heavens. The synopsis leans poetic and vague, promising an epic-scale journey without spelling out the specifics. It's a cultivation fantasy pitched on scale and mystique.
summaries.137683: Set generations after the founding of the Tang Sect, a once-great martial arts clan now in decline, this follows a prodigiously talented newcomer and a new generation of Shrek's Seven Monsters as they try to restore the sect's former glory. Ancient soul beasts, hidden weapons, and long-buried secrets from the sect's decline complicate their path. It's a martial-arts fantasy about reviving a fallen legacy.
summaries.138416: A collection of animated promotional videos for the mobile game Blue Archive, released periodically to accompany in-game events and anniversaries. They're short, stylish tie-in pieces rather than a connected narrative.
summaries.140842: Follows the small, sometimes happy and sometimes stressed daily life of Chiikawa, a tiny, endearingly cute creature getting by in a world of odd jobs and small pleasures. Alongside friends like bees and rabbits, Chiikawa works hard, eats well, and keeps smiling through it all. It's a gentle, bite-sized comedy about finding contentment in small routines.
summaries.141953: Guan Chao is hunting for the Burning Stone, the power source needed to reactivate the Time Gun and return to the past, when a wrong turn lands them inside the Memory Administration Bureau instead. Working alongside fellow memory administrators Fang Tang and Bai Zhong, they venture deeper into a stack of memory layers to hunt down escaped BUG Beings. It plays as an episodic sci-fi adventure, each cleared layer raising the stakes for whatever comes next.
summaries.142274: Set in the near future, this imagines the descendants of Japan's historic ninja clans, now scattered and diluted since the Meiji Restoration, banding together as the World Ninja Association to preserve their heritage. Their breakthrough, Ninja-Gum, unlocks shinobi-like powers, and a tournament is held to find whoever can wield the strongest version of it. It's an action premise built around a gum-based ninja tournament.
summaries.144779: A new entry in the Space Battleship Yamato franchise, serving as a direct sequel to the film Uchuu Senkan Yamato 2205: Aratanaru Tabidachi. Plot specifics beyond its place in the ongoing film series aren't detailed yet.
summaries.146004: A weekly series of short comedic YouTube videos starring VTuber Watame, originally released in a vertical format before being recompiled into widescreen editions. It's bite-sized, internet-native comedy built around her established persona rather than a scripted story.
summaries.151778: After three years locked away, a young man returns wielding an absurd, over-the-top arsenal of the strongest bloodlines, martial skills, and mystical techniques imaginable, at least on paper. The joke undercutting all that power is that his spirit animal companion turns out to be, of all things, a pig. It's a comedic riff on the overpowered-cultivator genre.
summaries.152181: A collection of short animated clips centered on the character Yugo, originally released on animator Tomoyasu Murata's YouTube channel. Each installment offers a brief, self-contained glimpse into Yugo's world rather than a continuous storyline, making it an easy, low-commitment watch for anyone who enjoys short-form character pieces.
summaries.153843: A 3D VTuber animation project for NoriPro, built entirely from scratch with original animation, voice acting, and scenario work. Beyond that introduction, further story details haven't been shared.
summaries.155723: The second season of Wushen Zhuzai, continuing the story from its first outing. No further plot information is given.
summaries.158871: A new entry in the long-running Pokemon anime, following a girl named Liko and a boy named Roy as they set out across the wider Pokemon world. It promises the series' familiar mix of adventure and discovery under new leads.
summaries.159309: The second season of Otomege Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai desu, continuing its story from where the first season left off. No additional plot details for this season are provided.
summaries.159454: A Cartoon Network Japan original spin on the classic Tom and Jerry cartoons, made to celebrate Japan's November 11 Cheese Day. It keeps the pair's fast-paced slapstick but wraps it in a cuter, more pop-flavored art style, joined by the diaper-wearing Tuffy Mouse from the original cartoons.
summaries.165159: Bird Kazami dreams of becoming a professional Blader and gets his shot when he meets former champion Ekusu Kurosu, known as Kamen X, forming a team aimed at the top of the X Tower. Their path leads toward battles unlike anything seen before, powered by the newly unveiled, super-accelerated X Beyblades. It's a competitive shonen sports premise built around a fresh evolution of the Beyblade format.
summaries.165524: Spans a hundred thousand years of a single cultivator methodically refining his Qi while everyone around him, his master, his fellow disciples, even an old gatekeeper dog and a tree, ascend to greater heights ahead of him. The joke is in the extreme patience of it all, as he finally breaks through after ten millennia stuck on a single, absurdly high floor of cultivation. It's a comedic take on the slow-burn cultivation genre, playing up the absurdity of a single character's glacial pace.
summaries.166219: The fourth season of Tunshi Xingkong, picking up around episode 86 of the overall story. No further plot details for this stretch are given.
summaries.166444: Online rivals in a competitive game, campus heartthrob Xiao He and freshman Shen Xin meet for real through a collegiate esports tournament and quickly grow close. Joined by friends Yang Yao and Xiang Nan, they form a team and push through every challenge on the road to the championship, encouraging and inspiring each other along the way. A breezy campus-esports romance about rivalry turning to partnership and feelings that slowly bloom.
summaries.168177: General Zichuan Xiu, already known for single-handedly executing a traitor deep within enemy territory, has risen to command hundreds of thousands of allied troops in the Far East. With the backing of the Sacred Temple's Guardian Elders, he now ascends to rule the Eastern lands as its new sovereign. It's a martial fantasy about a warrior's rise from soldier to king.
summaries.169080: The second season of Azur Lane: Bisoku Zenshin!, continuing its story from the first season. No further plot details are given.
summaries.169377: Kotarou, a Taiko drumming enthusiast from Taiko Village, sets off for Omiko City with his partner Don-chan to spread the joy of Taiko drumming to the world. It's a lighthearted, music-driven adventure premise.
summaries.169582: Prince Arnold is dismissed by the empire as a hopeless failure next to his gifted twin brother Leonard, but in secret he's Silver, one of only five SS-rank magic-wielding adventurers alive. When the crown prince's death ignites a vicious succession war, Arnold works from the shadows to put his twin on the throne for his own hidden reasons. It's a political intrigue fantasy built around a secret-identity underdog with real power to spare.
summaries.169583: Seven years after promising to stay friends forever, Hayato reunites with his childhood pal Haruki at their new high school, only to find the former tomboy has grown into the girl every guy in school is talking about. Looks aside, Hayato still sees the same friend he grew up with, and their old bond starts quietly turning into something more. A gentle, nostalgic romance about a promise that outlasts time and distance.
summaries.170497: A collection of short comedy episodes centered on Hakui Koyori, presented in an energetic, blink-and-you'll-miss-it format. It's built for quick laughs rather than an ongoing story, so expect rapid-fire gags over plot.
summaries.170660: The third season of Chickip Dancers continues the show's series of short dance performances. It picks up where the previous two seasons left off.
summaries.171110: This adaptation covers Part 3 of Honzuki no Gekokujou, picking up as Myne says goodbye to her old life and takes on the name Rozemyne, adopted daughter of an archduke. Thrust into a brutal noble world of etiquette and magic lessons alongside her duties as High Bishop, she finds motivation in an unexpected reward: access to the temple's library. It's a bibliophile's isekai fantasy about climbing a rigid social ladder for the sake of books.
summaries.176373: Set in a Kumamoto coastal town at the end of summer 1996, this short follows ten-year-old Minato, who lives a hard life with his alcoholic father and finds his only comfort in Ben-chan, a girl-shaped goddess only he can see. When the two are about to be separated, Minato makes a desperate wish to a mysterious light over the sea. A quiet, melancholy story about loneliness, hatred, and the price of a granted wish.
summaries.177637: Centuries ago, mermaid princess Lara traded her tail for legs and a chance at love with a human prince, knowing the magic would turn her to sea foam if she failed to find true love. Now, two hundred years later, she wakes in Lake Biwa with one last shot at life. A wistful fairy-tale romance about second chances and the cost of a wish.
summaries.177699: In a near-future 2029 Japan wired together by a vast information network, cyborg operative Motoko Kusanagi leads an elite unit within Public Security Section 9, tackling cybercrime and conspiracy at the government's request. As she and her team investigate an elusive hacker known only as the Puppet Master, the story leans into classic cyberpunk questions about identity and technology. A fresh entry point into the Ghost in the Shell franchise's blend of action and philosophy.
summaries.178125: When twelve world-protecting amulets are suddenly shattered, a curse begins spreading across the globe, except to Rokuro, who is somehow immune. Setting out with his older brother Goro and younger sister Nanako, and armed with a magic brush from a hermit, Rokuro begins a quest to save his family and undo the curse. A straightforward, family-driven adventure fantasy aimed at a younger audience.
summaries.178789: The third season of the Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu series continues its long-running isekai fantasy story. Viewers already invested in the earlier seasons will find this a direct continuation.
summaries.179860: A collection of animated promotional videos for the Aikatsu Academy! virtual YouTuber project, released on the Streaming Club's YouTube channel. These are short music and promo clips rather than a narrative series, including the tracks Mankai! Helianthe and HAPPY REFLECTION.
summaries.179916: On Lingwu Continent, power comes from spiritual cultivation or martial mastery, and Chen Tian was once a prodigy in his hometown until he mysteriously lost his abilities at age ten. Left humiliated and looked down upon, a near-fatal fall sends him into an ancient formation that awakens a rare dual cultivation gift, along with strange memories and a mysterious ring. A cultivation fantasy about a disgraced genius clawing his way back from rock bottom.
summaries.180136: Born into a family of celebrated swordsmen, Elymas is cast out when he awakens the supposedly worthless Heavy Knight class. Disowned and adrift, he regains memories of a past life in which this very world was a VR game he'd mastered, giving him knowledge no one else has. He sets out to use that edge to rebuild his life and prove his so-called weak class wrong. A game-knowledge isekai revenge story.
summaries.182205: The fourth season continues Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken as Demon Lord Rimuru pushes his dream of a human-monster alliance closer to reality. Tempest's growing prosperity draws tension with Granville and Maribel Rozzo, who want to protect humanity by ruling over it, while Demon Lord Leon pursues his own agenda in El Dorado. A continuation of the series' large-scale fantasy nation-building and diplomacy, with a new Hero's arrival on the horizon.
summaries.182616: The second season continues Nige Jouzu no Wakagimi, picking up directly from the first season's story. Returning viewers can expect more of the same blend the series is known for.
summaries.183231: Rilakkuma returns for another round of cozy, low-key stories about friendship, small changes, and everyday comfort. Whatever the day brings, this laid-back bear is there to make it feel a little lighter, an easygoing, stress-free watch for anyone who wants their anime gentle.
summaries.184356: When ancient tombs packed with divine, world-altering relics surface overnight, it triggers a worldwide scramble to claim them. Raider Jooheon Suh is betrayed and left for dead, but gets a second chance: a leap back to years before the relics ever appeared, giving him a head start to raid every tomb before they can rise. A revenge-driven adventure built around time, betrayal, and a race against fate.
summaries.184492: The fourth season finds Suzuki Iruma and the rest of the Misfit Class working to reach Rank 4 at their school's Music Festival. Continuing the demon-school comedy, it keeps the focus on found-family teamwork under performance pressure.
summaries.184872: This second season of Nitian Xie Shen continues the story across episodes 31 through 82. It picks up directly from where the first season left the cultivation-fantasy narrative.
summaries.185542: The second season continues Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechuu, following its skeleton-knight protagonist's isekai adventures from where the first season left off.
summaries.185646: Koupen-chan follows a small penguin and friends through gentle, low-stakes everyday moments. It's built around warmth and simplicity rather than plot, the kind of show meant to unwind to.
summaries.185692: The second season continues Kabushiki Gaisha Magi Lumiere, picking up the story from the first season.
summaries.185725: Trying to raise money for his mother's medical bills, junior student Ye Bufan attempts to scam a driver, but the woman behind the wheel doesn't play along, and after being hit by her car, he wakes up in a fantasy world instead. There he inherits ancient medical knowledge, picks up martial arts, and draws the attention of numerous women along the way. A comedic isekai mixing medicine, martial arts, and harem tropes.
summaries.185874: The fourth and final part of BLEACH: Sennen Kessen-hen brings the Thousand-Year Blood War to its climax, as the Soul Reapers and Quincies clash across a world showing signs of collapse. Ichigo and his allies face escalating threats from Yhwach's forces as the fight for the survival of the Three Worlds reaches its peak. The concluding chapter of one of shonen's longest-running sagas, promising an all-out final confrontation.
summaries.185875: Thirty years after unknown 'invasive alien species' nearly destroyed the world, humanity and these creatures remain locked in an uneasy struggle for territory, with extinction still a constant possibility. The task force EXCEEDS was formed to head off the disasters these invaders cause, and on the remote island nation of Mizuho, young hunter Shina Hisase fights to protect her one remaining family member, her sister Setsuna. A dark, kaiju-adjacent action series about survival under constant threat.
summaries.186151: A monthly short-anime series spotlighting original card themes from the Yu-Gi-Oh! Official Card Game, expanding on a demo reel released the previous year. It's aimed squarely at OCG players and fans following new card archetypes rather than a standalone story.
summaries.186495: The third season of this collaborative multimedia project between DECO*27 and Takuya Yamanaka continues releasing character-focused music videos over time, including tracks like 'Yuno - Life' and 'Kazui - Camouflage.' It's an ongoing music-driven, interactive storytelling project rather than a conventional episodic anime.
summaries.186833: After being transported to what looks like the Tang Dynasty, Ning Que finds himself in a harsh agricultural world rather than the life of luxury he expected, since he has no cultivation talent to speak of. Having survived the massacre of his family as a young child, he rescues an abandoned baby, Sangsang, and picks up a strange black umbrella that becomes his means of fighting back against a world that's already tried to kill him. A gritty cultivation-fantasy story about refusing to accept a cruel fate.
summaries.186837: A series of short episodes set in the Tian Guan Ci Fu world, presented in a compact, bite-sized format rather than a full-length narrative.
summaries.186863: Deep in a forest, a fire-breathing, human-hating dragon nicknamed 'Uncle Wing' is raised from birth by a mother cat, and grows up watching over her ever-curious feline friends, one who runs off on an adventure with a human prince, another who prefers people-watching in the city. Over time, the reluctant dragon starts to soften toward humans himself. A whimsical, gentle fantasy about found family and cats bridging an unlikely bond.
summaries.187166: Following its run taking the girls'-band world by storm, BanG Dream Chan returns for a big reunion of its cute, chibi-style band members. It's a lighthearted comedy spin-off built around music and character charm rather than serious plot.
summaries.187260: At a mysterious orphanage, girls with no families of their own are raised as living weapons, trained to kill without hesitation, all except Sheena, who just wants the surrounding conflict to end. After her roommate dies, Sheena meets a strange, blood-covered girl who turns up the next day as a new transfer student calling herself Mimi, rumored among the girls to be an unkillable secret weapon. When Mimi becomes her new roommate, Sheena is forced to live alongside someone who embraces death as fully as she wants to escape it. A dark, tension-filled drama about two girls with opposite relationships to mortality.
summaries.187538: High schooler Jirou Azuma comes from a line of ninjas, trained in shinobi arts and able to talk to animals. When he rescues an injured cat named Ragou, he learns the feline is actually the legendary Black Star of Doom, and the two are pulled into the Bureau of Espionage's fight against mononoke seeking to exploit Ragou's power. A supernatural action series blending ninja tradition with monster-of-the-week battles.
summaries.188036: Aotu World was built by a reckless, unfair god, but he left one way to rewrite your fate: enter the brutal Aotu Tournament, use the special abilities the system grants, and survive round after round to win. After a hundred years of dormancy, the tournament reopens, and King enters hoping to change the destiny of his home planet, Dengru, and track down his missing sister. A battle-tournament fantasy built around underdogs fighting for a better hand.
summaries.188139: Among the maidens from the Five Clans vying for the Crown Prince's heart, the jealous Keigetsu uses forbidden magic to swap bodies with her rival, the beloved Reirin. But the swap doesn't bring the happiness she hoped for: her new body's fragile health leaves her on the edge of death, while Reirin, now wearing the face of a disgraced outcast, is forced to answer for Keigetsu's past crimes at trial. Increasingly tangled in each other's lives, the two must cooperate to survive the conspiracies hiding beneath the palace's polished surface. A body-swap political fantasy about two enemies forced to depend on one another.
summaries.188388: In a world powered by 'e-Pulse,' human thought and emotion converted into energy for AI devices called Sapotama, Tomoro Tenma's life changes when Digimon start manifesting from these devices and feeding on the emotions that power them. After his own Sapotama produces the creature Gekkomon, Tomoro joins Glowing Dawn, a covert team investigating the rogue Digimon and the corrupted system behind them. A tech-driven reimagining of the Digimon premise built around emotion as both fuel and vulnerability.
summaries.188525: First-year high schooler Ai Yasumi lives on Izu Oshima and has always loved reading manga, until a turning point pushes her to start creating her own stories instead. The series follows her early steps into manga-making, along with the challenges and small victories that come with chasing a creative dream. A grounded, coming-of-age story about turning a love of art into the will to make something yourself.
summaries.188529: What if cats showed up in classic fairy tales? This series reimagines beloved old stories with tabby, orange, calico, and white cats woven into the action, aiming for a surreal, heartwarming spin on familiar tales. A gentle comedy built for cat lovers and fairy-tale fans alike.
summaries.188753: Based on Yuri Yokomizo's 'Nandemo Ikimono' characters, this monthly short series follows the everyday lives of essentially anything at all, animals, plants, food, and objects alike. Released across social media platforms like Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok as well as ABEMA, it's built for quick, bite-sized viewing rather than a long-form story.
summaries.189046: The fourth season continues Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu as Subaru sets out across a deadly desert in search of the Sage said to reside at the Pleiades Watchtower, hoping to save his stricken allies. It carries forward the series' blend of harrowing survival and emotional stakes for a cast that's already been through a great deal.
summaries.189717: A short spin-off anime commemorating the announcement of a movie based on the live-action medical drama Tokyo MER: Hashiru Kinkyuukyuumeishitsu. It reimagines the show's emergency-response characters as animals, giving fans of the original series a lighter, more whimsical take on its cast while the film is on the way.
summaries.190569: After losing her mother and homeland, Sitara channels her grief into a hunger for knowledge, finding a new home and education with a family of scholars. But as Genghis Khan's Mongol Empire sweeps closer, conquering nation after nation, she's taken captive by the empire's Fourth Prince, and a desire for revenge begins to take hold. A historical drama set against the backdrop of the Mongol conquests, following one girl's path from loss to defiance.
summaries.192800: Reincarnated from Japan into the kingdom of Theolas, Melody has one dream: to become the world's greatest all-purpose maid for a poor count's family. Through sheer skill and no small amount of magic, she turns cheap tea into fine brew and a crumbling mansion into something new, all without realizing that this world is secretly an otome game, and that she herself is its most powerful, unkillable heroine. Romance and demon lords can wait; for Melody, the job always comes first. A comedic isekai about a workaholic who's accidentally the strongest person in the room.
summaries.193883: The third installment following Chibi Godzilla no Gyakushuu 2 continues the chibi-style Godzilla comedy series. It picks up directly from the previous entry.
summaries.194219: In a world where humans and ayakashi coexist, powerful and beautiful ayakashi sometimes choose human women as their 'brides,' granting them prosperity in exchange for devoted love. Yuzu has always lived in her sister's shadow, her sister being the bride of a demon fox, and is resented at home for her ordinary life, until a strikingly beautiful man appears before her on a bridge and calls her his wife. A supernatural Cinderella-style romance about an overlooked girl suddenly chosen by someone powerful and cold-hearted.
summaries.194389: Koala Enikki follows Koala's daily life in diary form, taking the good days with the bad and choosing to see every one of them as worthwhile. It's a quiet, optimistic slice-of-life built around finding contentment in the everyday.
summaries.194829: The second season continues Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru, picking up the story of its sword-saint protagonist from where the first season left off.
summaries.195600: In an isolated mountain village watched over by two stone guardians, Yuru lives simply off the land, staying close to his twin sister Asa, the only family he has left. But Asa is bound to a mysterious 'duty' she performs on the village's behalf, kept locked away for it, and Yuru's peaceful home hides more secrets than he realizes. A quiet, unsettling fantasy mystery about twins and the price of a village's traditions.
summaries.195833: A sequel to the classic dodgeball manga Honou no Toukyuuji Dodge Danpei, this modern take follows Danpei's daughter Danko as she tries to build a dodgeball team with real fighting spirit in an apathetic 2025. A hot-blooded sports story about reviving old-school passion in a more indifferent era.
summaries.195885: The fourth season continues Shixiong A Shixiong, picking up its cultivation-comedy story from the previous installments.
summaries.196012: Mao is a mysterious onmyoji living in 1900s Taisho-era Japan, cursed centuries ago to remain alive for nine hundred years. His path crosses with Nanoka Kiba, a junior high schooler who seems to have arrived from the future and who has already survived her own share of trauma, including losing both parents in a horrific accident. When Nanoka returns to the shopping arcade where her life changed, she's pulled into Mao's era, one where supernatural ayakashi roam freely, and the two must team up against dark forces threatening them both. A supernatural mystery about two people from different times bound together by tragedy.
summaries.196017: Set in Japan's economic-boom years of the late 1950s and early '60s, this series follows traveling circus troupes competing for a spot in the prestigious 'Circus Collection' festival. The financially struggling Sunflower Circus, led by ringmaster Maria, gets a boost when they encounter a circus prodigy named Mizuka Tsurumaki. A period drama about chasing big dreams under the big top.
summaries.196187: Overworked salaryman Sasaki gets through each grueling shift on cigarettes and the warm smile of Yamada, the convenience-store clerk he always stops to see. One night, after a rough shift, he arrives to find Yamada gone, until a pierced stranger invites him to smoke with her instead. A quiet, character-driven drama about connection found in small breaks from an exhausting routine.
summaries.196218: Dias returns from war a hero, only to be granted land that turns out to be an empty, uninhabited frontier. Undaunted, he sets out to build a domain from scratch, and a chance meeting with Alna, a mysterious horned girl, brings his lonely grassland to life. A slow-building fantasy about world-building and found family rather than battle.
summaries.196219: Carolina has always seen herself as the overlooked daughter in a family full of prodigies, content to stay in her sister's shadow. That changes when a royal decree forces her into marriage with the fearsome "Bloodthirsty Prince" of a rival empire, pushing her into a world of court intrigue and danger. A political fantasy romance about a quiet girl finding her own strength.
summaries.196223: A new anime commemorating the 61st anniversary of Shoutarou Ishinomori's classic manga Cyborg 009. Longtime fans of the original series get a fresh adaptation to mark the milestone.
summaries.196241: Set on Guuguu Island, a whimsical world where every kind of food imaginable comes to life, this short follows Calvin, an apprentice galbi with big dreams of becoming the Yakiniku King's most popular menu item. Together with his friends, he travels the island chasing that goal, in a colorful, food-themed comedy aimed at younger viewers.
summaries.196356: Miya, the illegitimate daughter of a prominent family, moves in with her late mother's in-laws bracing for the cruel stepmother and stepsisters she's sure await her. Instead she finds them unexpectedly kind, upending everything she assumed about her new life. A warm, comedic spin on the wicked-stepfamily trope.
summaries.196613: The eighth season of the long-running Dou Po Cangqiong, covering episodes 158 through 219. A continuation for viewers already following this cultivation fantasy saga.
summaries.196974: Spica dreams of becoming a witch but can't cast a single spell, and without money or connections she has no way into the academy she wants. When a talking black cat offers to teach her in exchange for breaking his own curse, an odd master-apprentice bond begins. A lighthearted magic-school comedy about two mismatched partners chasing the same goal.
summaries.197178: A short adapting one chapter of the ONE PIECE HEROINES novel series, focused on Nami. After an uncomfortable pair of shoes sends her back to the shop, she's swept into an unexpected collaboration with the shop's designer and a skilled artisan. A brief, stylish side story for One Piece fans.
summaries.197715: In a world where birth locks people into fixed classes, villagers are meant to be the weakest of all — except Kouji Kagami, whose level caps out at an absurd 999. A monster hunt brings him face to face with Alice, the Demon King's daughter, and the two discover they want the same impossible thing: peace between humans and demons. A power-fantasy romance built around an unlikely alliance.
summaries.197754: Nao was raised to be relentlessly, almost foolishly honest, which makes her the worst possible fit for the high-stakes Liar Game, where winning means outwitting your opponent and losing buries you in debt. After being swindled out of a fortune on day one, she seeks out Akiyama, a genius con artist just released from prison, to even the odds. A tense psychological game of deception and shifting alliances.
summaries.198376: A group of girls suddenly find themselves debuting together as the virtual band Mugendai Mewtype, each bringing talent and personality but little idea how to function as a unit. The story follows their scramble to figure out performing as a group in a demanding music industry. A band-building idol drama in the BanG Dream! universe.
summaries.198409: After dying from overwork, office worker Arihito Atobe is reborn in the Labyrinth Country with the rare Rearguard class, a support role built for both healing and combat. Alongside a fierce demi-human mercenary and his former boss, he descends into dangerous dungeons to make a name for himself. A dungeon-crawling fantasy that centers a support character instead of a frontline fighter.
summaries.198560: In a fantasy world where the television has just been invented but swords and sorcery still rule daily life, camera crews start pushing into dungeons once known only to adventurers. Between monster attacks and constant equipment failures, the crew presses on toward the first live dungeon broadcast. A genre mashup that plays dungeon-crawling as behind-the-scenes broadcast drama.
summaries.198701: After ten thousand years asleep in the Cemetery of Gods and Demons, Chen Nan wakes to find himself already a legend, and his arrival in Yangjin Country kicks off a new round of adventures alongside Chen Xi. He fights through Kaiyuan City and the Death Zone while chasing answers about his own origins. A continuing donghua cultivation saga for returning viewers.
summaries.198706: The second season of Da Zhuzai, continuing the story through episodes 53 to 104. A direct continuation for viewers who followed the first season.
summaries.198709: Chloe is a spy whose mastery of disguise and combat makes even the hardest missions look easy, until her own boss betrays her. She vanishes and reinvents herself as Victoria, an ordinary citizen in a neighboring kingdom chasing a quiet, normal life. That plan doesn't last long once her old skills prove impossible to hide and a prince starts taking notice.
summaries.198946: The second season of Clevatess: Majuu no Ou to Akago to Kabane no Yuusha, continuing its dark fantasy story of demon king and hero lore.
summaries.199066: Ryuusei was once the Demon King; now he's a reclusive NEET quietly avoiding the world. That peace shatters when Meteor, the hero who once defeated him, reappears as an ordinary high school girl — and he ends up teaching at her school. A rom-com built on old rivals colliding again under very different circumstances.
summaries.199111: The third season of Grand Blue, continuing its raucous college diving-club comedy. For fans already invested in the cast's chaotic antics.
summaries.199363: The sixth season of Wanmei Shijie, covering episodes 235 through 286. A continuation for established viewers of this long-running cultivation series.
summaries.199408: Elizabeth Leiston seems destined to become queen of Haldoria, until her fiancé publicly breaks their engagement, jails her, and spreads vicious rumors about her. Backed by her loyal maid and armed with seven powerful grimoires, she decides revenge is more appealing than continuing to serve a country that never respected her. A vengeance-driven fantasy with a heroine who refuses to play victim.
summaries.199409: The fourth and final season of Yi Nian Yongheng, bringing the long-running cultivation epic to a close.
summaries.199603: When the Princess Teeniepings vanish without a trace during a train journey to an important gathering, a mysterious Legend Teenieping appears before Romi and sets a grand rescue mission in motion. Joined by a new team of Royal Teeniepings, Romi sets out on a magical-girl adventure built around teamwork and mystery.
summaries.199748: Luck, an S-rank mage, makes a final stand against the Demon King to protect his companions — and wakes up ten years later hailed as a legendary hero who died in battle. Unable to return to the life he had, he hides his identity and starts over as Lock, a lowly F-rank adventurer in a world that's moved on without him. A quiet, bittersweet take on the returning-hero fantasy premise.
summaries.200230: A cowardly, unnamed protagonist stumbles into meeting Mechako, leader of the Kaikigumi, an organization devoted to ghosts and other supernatural creatures that haunt humans. His involvement in reviving the group kicks off a string of strange but oddly not-scary happenings around him. A horror-comedy that leans more toward whimsical than frightening.
summaries.200375: Based on the mascot character for the temp staffing agency Improve, this anime follows Inpuru-kun as he takes on a string of bizarre, over-the-top temporary jobs. It's a light, comedic promotional series built around absurd workplace scenarios rather than an ongoing plot.
summaries.200637: The third season of Kimi no Koto ga Dai Dai Dai Dai Daisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo, continuing its harem comedy about juggling romance with a hundred girlfriends.
summaries.201514: Hinako Konohana has an image as the perfect, graceful young lady of her prestigious school, but behind closed doors she can't handle even basic chores. When ordinary student Itsuki Tomonari is roped in as her secret caretaker, he's stuck managing constant chaos to protect her reputation. A caretaking rom-com where forced proximity slowly turns into something softer.
summaries.201667: The second season of Bungou Stray Dogs Wan!, the chibi comedy spinoff of Bungou Stray Dogs. Short, gag-driven episodes featuring the series' cast.
summaries.202269: Kakeru Sorano is a withdrawn university freshman who keeps people at arm's length, until he meets Koharu Fuyutsuki, a blind girl who moves through the world with quiet warmth. When she mentions wanting to see fireworks someday, it sets something in motion in him, and the two grow closer while he looks for a way to make her wish real. A gentle, tender romance about connection despite differences.
summaries.202429: In third grade, quiet Tsubasa becomes close friends with Kyotaro, a boy the whole class admires, and the two share small, irreplaceable moments in their own private world. A sudden incident pulls them apart, and the story follows the decades that follow as it reflects on what their friendship meant. A slow, contemplative drama spanning more than thirty years.
summaries.202508: Renowned wine critic Yutaka Kanzaki dies leaving behind a wine collection worth billions, and a will that promises it to whoever can correctly identify a set of twelve legendary wines plus one that surpasses them all. Competing for the inheritance are his estranged son Shizuku, classically trained but resentful of his father, and Issei Tomine, the charismatic young critic Yutaka recently adopted. A prestige drama about family, legacy, and the world of fine wine.
summaries.202717: Based on the Chiikawa comic arc known as the "Siren Arc," this story starts when Usagi shows up with a flyer advertising a too-good-to-be-true island getaway full of rewards and free treats. Chiikawa and friends set sail anyway, joined by a skeptical Rakko, and find something unexpected waiting for them on the island. A cute, slightly eerie adventure in the Chiikawa style.
summaries.202851: The fifth season of Fanren Xiu Xian Zhuan, continuing the long-running cultivation saga for existing fans.
summaries.202957: The 23rd installment of the Precure franchise follows Anna Akechi, a junior high student who meets a fairy named Pochitan on her 14th birthday and is suddenly thrown back in time from 2027 to 1999. There she befriends Mikuru Kobayashi, an aspiring detective, and the two transform into Precures to stop a wave of thefts by mysterious Phantom Thieves. A mystery-flavored entry in the magical-girl franchise, mixing detective work with time travel.
summaries.203490: When her mother remarries during her first year of high school, Ito Hazui moves into a new household and suddenly finds herself with four younger step-brothers. She works hard to bond with her new family, even as the eldest, Gen, stays cool and distant on the surface. A family comedy about blending households and reading between someone's guarded exterior.
summaries.203880: Siblings Hinata and Kaoru wander into a forbidden mountain forest and end up befriending a fearsome serpent god who calls herself the "god of misfortune." Despite her intimidating looks, she turns out to be awkward and lonely, and the three settle into an odd, heartfelt friendship. A cozy comedy built around an unlikely bond.
summaries.204060: Jan Akiyama is a brash teenager determined to fulfill his grandfather's old rivalry by defeating Mutsuju Gobancho, only to end up facing off against Gobancho's granddaughter Kiriko instead. Their clash mirrors their grandfathers' feud, with Jan treating cooking as pure competition while Kiriko insists it's about heart. A cooking-battle series built on generational rivalry.
summaries.204269: The second season of Odekake Kozame, continuing its gentle slice-of-life episodes. A follow-up for fans of the first season.
summaries.204466: Kuroe Akaishi just wants an ordinary high school life, but a rare condition turns her into a giant kaiju whenever her emotions run too high. That becomes a serious problem once she develops feelings for the school's most popular boy, since every blush now risks a monster-sized incident. A romantic comedy built around keeping feelings, literally, under control.
summaries.204626: Set after humans and Metal Cardbots have settled into an uneasy coexistence on Earth, the story follows Jun, a boy chosen by the mysterious force known as Metal Breath, and his partner Blue Cop as they work to keep that peace. When a wild Cardbot surfaces carrying a secret tens of millions of years old, their world is thrown into new turmoil, kicking off a friendship-driven mecha adventure.
summaries.204656: Shark Meow is a laid-back orange tabby who wears a shark costume, moving through life at their own cozy pace alongside their best kitty friends and a rescued baby cat. The show lingers on small everyday pleasures — sunny park spots, the smell of roasted sweet potatoes, the first snow of the year. A soft, low-stakes slice-of-life meant purely for comfort.
summaries.204762: A three-part anthology series created by Azuki and Dentsu, with Gorou Taniguchi serving as creative producer. Little else about its individual stories has been revealed.
summaries.205772: Ame is a kid with a serious sweet tooth, and Caries — the literal tooth decay living in her mouth — treats her like a carefree home, even calling her "Mama." Ame's dental health stays entirely at Caries' mercy throughout. An odd, comedic premise built around a very literal cavity problem.
summaries.206194: The second season of Zhan Shen: Fanchen Shen Yu, continuing its cultivation-fantasy story.
summaries.206249: Set in 1910, Iwamoto Kodou is a young boy who has quietly carried out a string of unusual missions on the military's orders. Each assignment leads him into strange corners of history that have never been told. A historical mystery built around secretive, behind-the-scenes intrigue.
summaries.206270: The third season of Cang Yuan Tu, continuing its fantasy story for existing viewers.
summaries.206273: At his lowest point, the crippled youth Gu An seizes the power of an ancient god in a desperate, life-or-death moment. Armed with vast spiritual energy and a mortal blade, he sets out to strike down those who wronged him and defy the heavens themselves. A revenge-driven cultivation fantasy about a broken protagonist claiming power against impossible odds.
summaries.206282: Gu Feiyang, one of the strongest warriors of his era, finds his cultivation permanently capped and engineers a scheme to reincarnate and start over with a clean slate. He's reborn as Li Yunxiao, a teenage heir to a powerful military family in a kingdom besieged by outside enemies and internal succession struggles. A political cultivation-fantasy about a secretly experienced strategist rebuilding power from a position that looks weak.
summaries.206425: A third batch of short Sousou no Frieren spin-off shorts released alongside the TV anime's second season, each built around a different small magical premise. Bite-sized bonus content for fans of the main series.
summaries.206521: Twelve-year-old Oniyasha grows up performing with a traveling theater troupe in 14th-century Japan but can't shake the feeling that none of it means anything — why one performance succeeds and another fails, why people dance at all. A chance encounter sets him on a path that will reshape an entire art form. A fictionalized coming-of-age account of the founder of Noh theater, tracing an artist finding purpose in his craft.
summaries.206523: The latest entry in the long-running Pretty Series franchise and a new chapter within the AiPri line. Details on story and characters are still emerging.
summaries.206682: Pantan, a red panda, is searching for treasure said to be hidden in a rainbow star, hoping to keep a promise made to an adventurer long ago. When his path crosses Anpanman's, the two team up, with Anpanman lending his powers to help Pantan reach his goal. A gentle, adventure-driven entry in the Anpanman franchise.
summaries.206819: Two Tokyo high schoolers form a connection over a painting of fireworks, and their curiosity about its origins leads them to the Nagaoka Fireworks Festival in Niigata, one of Japan's three major firework displays. Along the way they uncover a mysterious promise linking the two of them to the past. A quiet mystery-romance built around shared curiosity and old secrets.
summaries.206950: The third season of Kumarba, continuing its story for returning viewers.
summaries.207084: In the remote, tech-forgotten Kagami Village, middle schooler Akane has spent a year waiting for her older sister Sui to come home from the hospital. Local folklore warns that misbehaving children get taken by a 'Double,' and not long after Sui's return, Akane gets an anonymous call insisting the sister living with her isn't really Sui. It sets up a quiet, unsettling mystery about identity and whether the person you love is still who they seem to be.
summaries.207141: Yani is a catgirl whose life revolves around one thing: chain-smoking, to the point that her apartment is buried in ash and cigarette butts (and general trash). Every attempt to quit collapses the moment a craving hits, and the show follows her comedic, mildly pathetic spiral of self-sabotage. It's a slice-of-life comedy about bad habits and whether she'll ever get it together.
summaries.207254: Three ordinary schoolboys stumble onto a DVD that opens a gateway to a parallel Earth overrun by aliens, and when one boy's little sister wanders through and gets kidnapped, the trio has to follow. In this hyper-realistic alternate world their cartoonish bodies suddenly make them superhuman, so they set out on a goofy, action-packed rescue mission. It plays like a lighthearted adventure-comedy built around a fish-out-of-water premise.
summaries.207534: An assassin from the Tai Xuan Tower and the holy maiden of the Jiu Xuan Sect are forced into a marriage of convenience, and their wedding night promptly turns into a failed assassination attempt when both discover they're immortal. What follows is a marriage of mutual deception, as each searches for a sect treasure while hiding a bigger secret: both are survivors of destroyed alien worlds now facing a shared cosmic threat. It blends wuxia romance with science fiction, building an alliance out of suspicion between two people who can't quite trust or kill each other.
summaries.207674: Shizuka is a self-described ordinary high schooler whose only quirk is a knack for attracting ghosts, which makes her the go-to assistant for famous psychic exorcist Kamui. His spiritual power is immense, but his exorcism methods are anything but conventional, and the show leans hard into loud, over-the-top comedy as Shizuka gets dragged through one supernatural disturbance after another. Expect a manic, high-energy take on the exorcist genre rather than a serious one.
summaries.207809: A mysterious hand pulls modern Japanese teenager Yuri beneath a puddle, and she wakes up in the Hittite Empire of the 14th century BCE, right in the middle of a bloody succession struggle. Alongside Prince Kail she has to dodge assassins and court conspiracies just to survive, eventually gaining a reputation as the goddess Ishtar. It's a historical fantasy about a girl caught between the ordinary life she left behind and the destiny she's stumbled into.
summaries.208044: The great sage Ephtal died in despair, having never reached the peak of his own magic, but four centuries later he's reborn with all his memories and power intact. He arrives in an era where magic has decayed so badly that his old spells look like miracles, and he wastes no time enrolling at a prestigious academy to set the record straight. It's a classic reincarnation power fantasy about an overqualified genius shaking up a world that's forgotten what real magic looks like.
summaries.208105: These are short chibi-style clips of Yani Neko posted to the main series' official YouTube channel and Twitter account. They're bite-sized bonus content rather than a standalone story, aimed at fans who already enjoy the parent series' style of humor.
summaries.208225: Elsa, daughter of a fallen aristocratic house, is stunned when elite nobleman Julius proposes marriage, wondering why someone so distinguished would want her. He's warm and gentle right up until the wedding, then abruptly turns cold, telling her plainly that he has no intention of ever loving her. It sets up a marriage-of-convenience romance built around slowly thawing a spouse who's declared his feelings a lost cause from day one.
summaries.208754: Set within Sword Art Online, the full-dive VRMMO where death in-game means death in real life, this follows Emirun and Rex, two acquaintances from the outside world who reunite by chance inside the game. They join a scouting party to learn how to survive, but after a devastating encounter with the enigmatic Black Swordsman wipes out their group, they seek training from the legendary Asuna to grow stronger. It's a side story about grief, resolve, and forging a new path forward inside a death game.
summaries.208829: The Nohara family travels to Hiroshi's hometown of Akita for a famous summer fireworks festival, but an incident sets loose a horde of youkai that start causing chaos across Japan. Chasing the problem to its source, the family ends up in the youkai realm itself, a strange and oddly nostalgic world, for an unpredictable family adventure. It's the usual blend of Crayon Shin-chan's slapstick comedy and heartfelt family antics, just with a supernatural road trip attached.
summaries.209504: Rin Takanashi, a thirtysomething caregiver, gets unceremoniously discarded as useless after being summoned to another world as a saint. Luckily for her, she's an outdoors and camping enthusiast at heart, and she's blessed with a 'Survival' skill (plus one more) that lets her wander the isekai with a camper van, picking up companions and enjoying good food along the way. It's set up as a cozy, gourmet-travel isekai comedy, though the story hints it won't stay quite that relaxing.
summaries.209541: This third season of PetitCure brings back familiar spots like the Mysterious Amusement Park and Candy Paradise while adding new locations, including a performance stage. New PetitCure fairy friends join the existing cast for more of the show's signature cute, heartwarming, and gently funny stories. It's aimed squarely at young kids who already love the franchise's mascot-style charm.
summaries.209669: This is the second season of Hanazakari no Kimitachi e, continuing directly from the story told in the first season. As a direct continuation rather than a fresh starting point, it's best approached by viewers who've already seen the original series.
summaries.209800: This is the second part of Yoroi Shinden Samurai Troopers, continuing the story begun in its first installment. Since it picks up where that part left off, it's meant for viewers already following the series rather than newcomers.
summaries.209961: This theatrical follow-up to Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu follows Yuuki, a professional survivor of deadly organized games, as she continues her run after clearing the notorious 'Thirty Game Wall' that kills off most competitors. Her next challenge is a game called Cloudy Beach on a remote island, where eight players gather, including seasoned veterans she already knows. It's a tense death-game thriller about a woman who keeps making a living by staying alive when almost no one else does.
summaries.209983: This is the second season of Hell Mode: Yarikomi-zuki no Gamer wa Haisettei no Isekai de Musou Suru, continuing its story for viewers who've already seen the first season. It picks up the ongoing isekai gamer premise rather than starting fresh.
summaries.210031: This is the second season of Seihantai na Kimi to Boku, carrying its story forward from the first season. It's built for existing viewers rather than as a jumping-on point for newcomers.
summaries.210687: The fourth season of Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Kyuukei Jikan (Break Time), continuing this spin-off's short-form take on the Re:Zero cast. It's aimed at fans already familiar with the main series and its characters.
summaries.211181: The fourth part of Mu Shen Ji, continuing the story from its previous installments. As with the earlier parts, it's meant to be watched in sequence rather than as a standalone entry.
summaries.211220: Adapted from a novel by Wen Zhou, this follows Li Xiongmao, a human boy raised among demons, who is sent by his master to leave Black-White Mountain and hunt down the three enemies blamed for the demons' downfall. As his search continues, he starts uncovering the real story behind the human-demon conflict, a dynasty's hidden secrets, and his own origins. It reads as an action fantasy built around a mystery the protagonist is only beginning to understand.
summaries.211232: A short film screened exclusively at Cinema Orion inside Ghibli Park in Nagakute, set within the park's own 'Valley of the Witches' area. It's the first original animated short Studio Ghibli has made specifically for the park, giving visitors a small standalone story tied to that location.
summaries.211308: Princess Sapphire loses everything when a calamity called 'Nergal' destroys her homeland of Silverland, and she arrives in Goldland at her lowest point. The kindness of the people there slowly gives her something to hold onto, until Nergal resurfaces and threatens to bring the same devastation to her new home. She picks up a sword and ties on her ribbon to fight back, in a story explicitly inspired by Osamu Tezuka's Princess Knight.
summaries.211711: This short anime adapts the 'I Am a Hero Too' bonus manga chapter, telling a story centered on Eri now that she's grown into a high schooler. It's a small side story for existing My Hero Academia fans rather than an entry point for newcomers.
summaries.212309: This is a sequel to Transformers: Wild King, continuing that series' story and cast. It's intended for viewers who've already watched the original rather than as a standalone starting point.
summaries.212652: The second part of Kidou Keisatsu Patlabor EZY, continuing directly from its first installment. It initially releases as a limited theatrical pre-screening before its wider release.
summaries.212969: Orphan Qin Yu earns a rare spot at the prestigious Dongda Martial Academy, a top school for cultivators, just as a demonic threat starts quietly closing in on the city beneath its calm surface. He vows to rally his fellow disciples to stand against the coming invasion. It's a school-set cultivation action series built around an underdog rising to meet a looming threat.
summaries.213097: This is the second season of TOMICA & TOM, continuing the toy-car-themed adventures established in its first season. It's aimed at young fans of the Tomica toy line already following the show.
summaries.213102: A slice-of-life short following two seals, Eru and Aru, as they while away their days together in cozy, low-stakes fashion, playing at home, watching TV, and napping after they've worn themselves out. It's a gentle, soothing iyashikei piece with no real conflict, made for unwinding rather than following a plot.
summaries.213188: On the Canglan Continent, where power comes from bonded martial spirits, Qin Nan of the Qin family was long dismissed as a hopeless case with no spirit of his own, until he awakens the soul of an ancient war god. That turning point sends him up against sect prodigies and formidable enemies as he claws his way toward strength no one expected from him. It's a cultivation power-fantasy sequel about an underdog's rise built on grit and a legendary awakening.
summaries.213356: This is the second season of Guangyin Zhi Wai, continuing its story from the first season. It's intended for viewers already following the series rather than as an introduction to it.
summaries.213359: This is the seventeenth season of Yami Shibai, continuing the anthology's run of short entries. It's aimed at longtime viewers already familiar with the format rather than newcomers.
summaries.213426: Kikkun is an alien who traveled to Earth as part of an invasion force, but the team assigned to Japan finds the country so comfortable that they start to forget why they came. Rather than conquering it, they end up wanting to protect Japan and the planet instead. It's a lighthearted comedy about invaders who accidentally go native.
summaries.213427: This animated series is built around Lotte's Pie no Mi snack brand and releases on Lotte's official YouTube channel, with one new episode posted each month. It functions as ongoing promotional content tied to the snack rather than a traditional standalone story.
summaries.213428: This is a yuri anime centered on live streamers. Given how little else is specified, it appears to focus on the relationships and dynamics between women working in the streaming world.
summaries.213484: Restaurant owner Ming, pushed to the edge of despair, swallows the soul of the true King Lie in a desperate bid to save someone he loves, binding their fates together. With only a hundred days to change their destiny, Ming leans on his extraordinary memory to relearn long-lost magic, gather allies, and win over ordinary people as he and the king's soul move to challenge the tyrant who stole the throne. It's a political fantasy about an unlikely pair racing against time to topple a corrupt regime.
summaries.213665: Katrina, the illegitimate daughter of a count and his maid, has had a hard life that only got worse after her mother's death, as her stepmother and stepsister's treatment of her grew crueler. When her stepsister is ordered north to be reformed under a prince rumored to be cold and merciless, the countess sends Katrina in her place instead, and Katrina arrives braced for the worst. What she actually finds is a prince kinder than his reputation suggests, setting up a quiet romance between two people who've both been misjudged.
summaries.213666: College student Akihito is fixated on looks and sex and has an odd, gnawing irritation with the handsome, aloof Sae, which comes to a head after Akihito gets rejected at a mixer by a girl interested in Sae instead. Following Sae in frustration, he discovers Sae's secret, that he's gay and has been struggling to feel any pleasure from sex, and Akihito decides breaking through that barrier is exactly the challenge he needs. It's an adult BL romance about two very different men getting under each other's skin.
summaries.213703: Part of the Capsules Project, an anthology of short animated films made by an experienced Chinese production team under the banner of extreme emotion, independent theme. This entry, Miracle, is one of several stylistically varied shorts in the collection, created to showcase original storytelling and help emerging Chinese animators reach an international audience.
summaries.213750: This special short commemorates the tenth anniversary of the Bananya series. It follows someone who wakes up in an unfamiliar world to find a cat peeking out of a banana, a 'Bananya,' and realizes their own body has somehow become a banana too.
summaries.213831: Snack HAZAMA is a weekly mini anime that airs alongside each episode of Ushiro no Shoumen Kamui-san, exclusively on the AT-X broadcast and online through OceanVeil. It functions as companion content to the main series rather than a standalone story.
summaries.213847: This eight-episode limited series is part of the new Star Wars: Visions Presents banner, which gives filmmakers room to tell longer Star Wars: Visions stories instead of one-off shorts. Picking up not long after the earlier Visions shorts, it follows Lah Kara as she continues training in the ways of the Jedi under Margrave Juro, joining his small fellowship of Jedi-in-training on a quest of self-discovery to save her father.
summaries.213861: This is the second season of Let's Roll, Cinnamoroll!, continuing the character-driven shorts from its first season. It's aimed at fans of the Cinnamoroll franchise already familiar with the format.
summaries.213908: Set in August 1987, this follows a single day in the life of Tokko, who stays behind alone in a large house while the rest of her family is away. It's a quiet, small-scale slice-of-life story built around solitude and routine rather than incident.
summaries.213961: This is the second season of Youjo Shenki, continuing as a chibi parody of Youjo Senki. Expect the same franchise's characters and setting played for comedy in a shorter, deliberately silly format rather than the original's serious tone.
summaries.214031: This short animation was created for Mob Psycho 100's tenth anniversary and debuted at the 'Mob Psycho 100 10th Anniversary Reunion Event' in Fukagawa Mirai Hall. It's a commemorative piece for longtime fans of the series rather than new story content aimed at newcomers.
summaries.214068: Amid a primordial ocean of stars, two identical, innocent children share a single vessel that drifts down onto a strange, in-between world, where a mischievous spirit appears to guide them through the nine months ahead. Meanwhile, in the world we know, a grieving, pregnant woman wrestles with sorrow and uncertainty. It's a quietly poetic, dual-perspective meditation on birth, loss, and the space between them.
summaries.214070: A girl arrives on the surface of a harsh, dangerous world and meets a boy already prepared to face its threats, each of them there for their own purpose. As the world around them gradually comes apart, it does so not just physically but digitally, atom by atom and datum by datum. It's a short, atmospheric piece blurring the line between a crumbling physical world and a collapsing simulated one.
summaries.214074: A short anime tie-in to the live-action tokusatsu series Kamen Rider Zeztz, released through Toei's Tokusatsu Fanclub streaming service. It's a bite-sized companion piece for fans following the Zeztz franchise rather than a standalone story, expanding on the live-action show's world in animated form.
summaries.214259: Nie Li travels to the Demon God Sect, where he makes new friends and sets off on a fresh leg of his journey, vowing to overthrow the Holy Emperor and protect the City of Glory. It's a continuing chapter of an ongoing cultivation action saga rather than a jumping-on point for newcomers.
summaries.214260: In a chaotic era ruled by treacherous officials and overrun by demons and monsters, the Netherworld invades and its wild gods start bullying ordinary people, until a snake-catcher named Xu Ying finally snaps. Enraged, he commits the near-unthinkable sin of killing a god and also takes down a corrupt court official, putting both the mortal and Netherworld realms on his trail. What follows is a dark fantasy chase story about one man's rebellion against gods and men alike.
summaries.214539: A collection of promotional animated videos made for the smartphone game Stella Sora, released individually over time rather than as a continuous series. Each short clip highlights a different angle of the game's world and characters, aimed at fans following the title rather than newcomers looking for a self-contained story.
summaries.214829: This entry continues a sprawling fantasy saga set after a great war left the world edging toward chaos and encroaching darkness. Various emperors, warriors, and mystical figures travel between kingdoms trying to hold the abyss at bay, navigating shifting alliances and uneasy omens along the way. It's an epic, mysticism-heavy continuation leaning on found-family bonds, asking whether love and faith can hold together a fracturing world.
